description: Kill an `fsync_` token. Any build or CI job using it stops being able to sync schemas immediately, and it cannot be restored — mint a new one and update the secret. `confirm` must be the token id exactly. Ask the human first. Needs workspace:manage.

confirm.description: The exact sync token id, typed to authorize this irreversible action. Ask the human to confirm it first — do not fill this in from context on your own.

name: fillo_revoke_sync_token
title: Revoke a form sync token
